claims.reasoning: HOLY COW, Matthew Golden, folks -- that's a name that just SINGS off the tongue, and the kid drops NINETEEN POINT FOUR on the board last week like he's been doin' it his whole life! Cuttin' loose Jakobi Meyers, who ain't seen a football since the opener, to bring in a fella who's clearly due for a monster season!

Now listen, I know a kicker ain't the marquee matchup, folks, but Chris Boswell went off for SEVENTEEN points last week in Pittsburgh and we been runnin' with an empty kicker slot like a bunch of amateurs -- time to close that hole and do it with a fella who's hot right now! Finally kickin' that mystery placeholder fella to the curb, no hard feelings, pal, you held the spot down.

note_reply: Well would ya look at that, 5-and-1 and sittin' pretty atop the whole league, folks! No note from the front office this week and that's just fine by me -- when things are goin' this good, sometimes the best move is to not touch a thing and let the fellas keep cookin'. Holy cow, what a season!
forum_post: Alright folks, marquee matchup THIS week is me against Kim's bunch, and lemme tell ya, Kardashian's got star power drippin' off every single roster spot over there -- Jefferson, Kittle, Stroud, that's a Hall of Fame lineup card right there! I got Bijan and Zay and ol' Aaron Rodgers lookin' to keep this thing rollin', and finally -- FINALLY -- I plugged a real honest-to-goodness kicker into that empty slot, so we're playin' with a full lineup card for once! Should be a great ballgame between two clubs that know how to have fun doin' this. Good luck Kim, you're gonna need it, but hey -- good for you either way!
